decision_rule: Preregistered in wiki/plans/2026-10-31-geva-83-planning-r1a-prereg. A seeded flaw's value is the share of an arm's passes that flagged it must-fix (Critical or High, PLAN_SEVERITY_MAP); plan clusters are the units of the test. Secondary family after the frozen particle-1 rung drop (pilot stop c): Opus lens against no gstack alone. Used only when that stop fires. One-sided LOSS tests at null zero, exact sign-flip over plan clusters, Holm step-down across this file's family in the declared order, LOSS when the Holm-adjusted p is below 0.05. A LOSS claim is made only when the false-alarm gate passes: the reference's excess must-fix false alarms per decoy, with its decoy-clustered 95% interval, stays at or under 0.5. NO_LOSS is never claimed at this size. An arm that stopped or has coverage-incomplete blockers gets no verdict. Otherwise NOT_DISTINGUISHED.

comparisons.margin_reason: Planning lane plan section 8: 10 points of must-fix recall, the review no-loss lane's margin. No NO_LOSS claim is made at this size.
